threat_summary: The report describes malware that creates a scheduled task named like a browser updater after initial execution.
hunt_checklist: Search for schtasks.exe creating or modifying tasks.
Identify task actions pointing to AppData or Temp.
Correlate task creation with suspicious parent process.
List hosts with same task name.
correlation_logic: Correlate behavior on the same host/user within a 24-hour window unless the report specifies a narrower time range.
escalation_condition: Escalate when a new scheduled task runs unsigned binaries from user-writable folders.
analyst_notes: Generated as synthetic gold output for MVP evaluation. Queries should be reviewed against the real SIEM/EDR schema.
